• Director 2 (appointed 4 May 2015) | | **Shareholders** | • Harmoni Holdings Sdn. Bhd. (company) – 70 %
• Director 1 – 21.05 %
• Director 2 – 8.95 % | | **Key Financials (RM)** | **Revenue** grew from 6.56 M (2022) → 6.78 M (2023) → 7.28 M (2024).
**Net profit** peaked at RM 307,580 (2023) after a dip in 2022 (RM 248,490) and fell to RM 278,301 (2024).
**Total assets** rose to RM 8.17 M (2024) with equity at RM 2.73 M. | | **Profitability** | Gross‑margin ~21‑24 % (2022‑2024). Net‑margin modest, 3.8‑4.5 % (2022‑2024). EBITDA margins around 10 % each year. | | **Liquidity** | Quick ratio slipped from 1.32 (2022) → 1.17 (2023) → 0.98 (2024). Cash‑to‑revenue fell from 10 % to 5 % over the three years, indicating tighter cash position. | | **Leverage** | Debt‑to‑equity (leverage ratio) stayed near 2.0 (2022‑2024). Interest‑coverage improved from 2.92× (2022) to 3.30× (2023) then to 2.94× (2024). | | **Operational Efficiency** | Cash conversion cycle ~121 days (2022‑2023) improved to ~94 days in 2024. Days sales outstanding fell from 123 days (2022) to 94 days (2024). | | **Recent Litigation** | • **CASE‑2024‑1172** – Debt recovery (plaintiff) – Dismissed (claim RM 288,900).
• **CASE‑2022‑1830** – Debt recovery – Judgment entered (claim RM 275,600).
• **CASE‑2022‑9438** – Debt recovery – Withdrawn (claim RM 24,400). | | **Audit** | All three FYs (2022‑2024) audited by “Audit Firm 1” with an **unqualified** opinion. | **Overall picture** Kirana Mutiara Farm is a small‑to‑mid‑size, Labuan‑based plantation operator with steady revenue growth and stable, though modest, profitability. The firm is heavily owned by Harmoni Holdings (70 %) and the two directors. Liquidity has weakened over the last two years, while leverage remains high (~2 ×). The company has been involved in a few debt‑recovery suits, one of which resulted in a judgment against it, but the most recent case was dismissed. The financial statements have consistently received clean audit opinions.
